SELECT r.id, r.type_id AS typeId, t.name AS typeName, r.title, r.summary, r.cover, r.file_url AS fileUrl, r.video_url AS videoUrl, r.author, r.view_count AS viewCount, r.download_count AS downloadCount, r.status, r.addtime FROM t_xuexiziliao r LEFT JOIN t_ziliaoleixing t ON t.id = r.type_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT d.id, d.resource_id AS resourceId, d.user_id AS userId, d.content, d.addtime, COALESCE(x.name, u.username) AS username FROM discussxuexiziliao d LEFT JOIN t_users u ON u.id = d.user_id LEFT JOIN t_xueyuan x ON x.user_id = d.user_id WHERE d.resource_id = #{resourceId} ORDER BY d.addtime DESC, d.id DESC
